name: trickle-lite
description: Real-time runtime type monitoring for TypeScript: see what your values actually are, and where the declared types drift from them.

scripts.test: npm run build && node vscode/build.mjs && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.vscode:package: node vscode/build.mjs && cd vscode && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o trickle-lite.vsix
